candidate_list_scoring.scope_disclosure: Per implementation.md deviation #8, this run's scorer checks numeric-equivalence-only against three closed forms: INV-A1, INV-1, INV-2prime (not full symbolic equivalence against all 19 candidate-list.yaml entries). This is a disclosed scope limit on 'scored-candidate-list.json'-equivalent output, applied to every front point at every completed complexity level (1 through 6) across all 14 targets.
candidate_list_scoring.matches_found_note: Zero matches to INV-A1, INV-1 or INV-2prime were found anywhere in any target's front OR full collision set (683 total collision-set entries examined) at any completed complexity level 1-6.

INV-A1.note: INV-A1 (Delta_random = 1 - m*(B-1)/N) has canonical node count 9 under the frozen node-counting rule, strictly greater than C_complete=6. No expression at this node count could have been enumerated by this run regardless of any numeric match; the candidate-list verdict for INV-A1 is therefore UNDECIDABLE from this run's data alone, not 'no match'. This is a scoping fact per specification.yaml's own complexity_cap clause, not an interpretation of the scientific result.

INV-1.note: Canonical node count 9 (mean formula), strictly greater than C_complete=6; same undecidability as INV-A1 above. INV-1 is not itself a Delta or E_3 target of this run.

INV-2prime.note: Node count 5 (E[Delta]_with_replacement = 1 - 1/N) IS within C_complete=6. Genuinely searched and NOT found among any Delta-target front point or full collision set through complexity 6. One structurally similar 2-constant expression was found (E_arms_fb3_high_bit_interval::Delta, complexity 5, sub(CONST,div(CONST,N)), const_values [0.99999999999999978, 217.30755042541787]) but its second free constant (217.3) does not match INV-2prime's implied coefficient (1), so it is correctly not flagged as a match by the numeric-equivalence scorer.
